policy: Seven origin cohorts; adult occupational/royal role assigned once at eighteen; artisan professions rotate across craft, trade, medicine, law and entertainment. One quarter free, three quarters Premium. Canonical career IDs validated, including poacher_job. Reload checkpoints at twelve, thirty and fifty.
